notes.title: Happy Holidays From Mastiff - Loads of Sales and Promotions!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/f8d7d82894f69fdb8c5a6099fc0aca1543169bd1.png[/img]

[b]- STEAM WINTER SALE -[/b]

Grab a cup of hot coco and cozy up in front of the warm glow of your screen because the Steam Winter Sale is live! 

From now through January 4 at 10:00am PST unwrap the holiday savings and pick up the critically-acclaimed action-RPG, [b]Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure[/b] and other action-packed titles from Mastiff like [b]Heavy Fire: Shattered Spear[/b], [b]Heavy Fire: Afghanistan[/b], and [b]Reload[/b].

You can also pick up all three shooters in the [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/80562/]Heavy Fire + Reload Triple Pack[/url][/b] at an even bigger discount!

You've been good all year long, so treat yourself, or send any of these games as a [b]gift[/b] to those special people on your "nice" list!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/322290/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/385600/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/305980/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/330370/

Don't miss out! These jolly good prices are only valid up until January 2 at 10:00am PST!


[b]- 3DS POCKET MONSTERS -[/b]

If you're looking for some RPG action on the go, join Parin and her monster pals in Gurumin 3D: A Monstrous Adventure, which will be on sale for [b]60% off[/b] on the Nintendo eShop on Nintendo 3DS™ across PAL-supported territories (EU) starting December 31 and running through January 14! You can purchase the game directly from your 3DS or by clicking [url=http://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/Nintendo-3DS-download-software/Gurumin-3D-A-Monstrous-Adventure-1149772.html]HERE[/url]! 

Can't get enough Gurumin? Head over to the Theme Shop on your 3DS. There you'll find several Gurumin themes waiting to decorate your home screen. Each theme features unique art, game folders, and music straight from the game!


[b]- IT'S PARTY TIME ON NINTENDO SWITCH -[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/93d5b1e820ae5e05c938be501cdf0bdee6e660ca.png[/img]
For you Nintendo Switch owners out there, Mastiff also just released [url=http://www.partyplanetgame.com]Party Planet[/url], a compilation of 30 party-games for up to 4 players. It's the perfect gaming compliment to any holiday or New Year's Eve party, and it's fun for players of all ages and skill levels! Pick it up today from [url=https://www.gamestop.com/nintendo-switch/games/party-planet-only-at-gamestop/153904]GameStop[/url],
 [url=https://www.ebgames.ca/Switch/Games/739242]EB Games[/url], or from the [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/party-planet-switch]Nintendo eShop[/url] on Nintendo Switch!


[b]- PSN END-OF-YEAR-WAREHOUSE CLEARANCE SALE -[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7923016/a88e572344b0e249d70cf2da81db8130c5cf490f.jpg[/img]

If you're looking for some solid throwbacks, Mastiff's End-of-Year Warehouse Clearance Sale is currently underway on PSN! Act fast! Supplies are limited!

• Save 50% on [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP9000-NPUD20847_00-0000000000000000]La Pucelle: Tactics[/url] 
• Save 67% on [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP9000-NPUJ01552_00-0000000000000001]Dirt Jockey[/url]


[b]- JOIN THE MASTIFF ELITE -[/b]

...and don't miss a gaming beat! Join the newly launched [b][url=http://mastiff-games.us16.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=6122b594701351cd90cec94f3&id=c2ac6614d3]Mastiff Newsletter[/url][/b] to stay up to date on upcoming releases, sales, giveaways, and more!

[b]Wishing you a Happy Holiday & a Happy New Year! We'll see you in 2018.
-Mastiff[/b]

notes.title: Reload is Coming Friday, 2/13!!
notes.content:
If you enjoyed Heavy Fire, you have to check out [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/330370/]Reload[/url], available this Friday at a 10% launch discount.

Reload is a realistic weapons and tactics trainer for one to four players that also happens to be a super fun, super fast playing game. 


Features 
[list]
 [*]120+ medals, rankings, and achievements 
 [*]35+ Scenarios including Hostage Rescue, Sniping, VIP Protection, Olympic  [*]Style Shooting, Heavy Weapons and more 
 [*]25+ weapons and accessories 
 [*]Co-op multiplayer play for up to 4 players and Head To Head Play for 2 Players (one machine) 
 [*]High quality graphics designed for 1080p 
 [*]Steam Cloud, Leaderboards, and Achievements

notes.title: Full Big Picture Support & Various Bug Fixes Are Live!
notes.content:
All the changes in the previous Beta are now live, plus a few additional bug fixes

Changelog Overview:
- Full Big Picture support
- New launcher: Can be controlled by mouse/keyboard or connected gamepads.
- Gamepad can be now used as a main player's controller (choose 'main controller' in the launcher).  Four player mode with all players on game controllers now fully supported. Note: The  Xbox 360 controller cannot be used to navigate or exit the Options Menu in gameplay
- Dodge/Jump movement with Gamepad issue fixed
- [Esc] key used to cancel user 'sign in'
- Improved save file system
- Readme files now displaying properly when using in-home streaming
- Long names no longer split into two lines on Hall of Fame
